section_label: Annexure A -- mandatory terms for the IA-client advisory agreement, plus the annual audit report deadline

obligations.title: Submit annual audit report and adverse findings by Oct 31 deadline
obligations.key_phrase: not later than October 31st of each year for the previous financial year

obligations.title: Ensure required terms and conditions incorporated in IA-client agreement
obligations.key_phrase: Investment Adviser shall ensure that the following terms and conditions are incorporated in the Investment Advisory Agreement

obligations.title: No advice or fee charged until agreement signed
obligations.key_phrase: Investment Adviser shall neither render any investment advice nor charge any fee until the client has signed this agreement

obligations.title: No managing client funds or securities
obligations.key_phrase: Investment Adviser shall not manage funds and securities on behalf of the client

obligations.title: No implying assured or guaranteed returns
obligations.key_phrase: shall not, in the course of performing its services to the client, hold out any investment advice implying any assured returns

obligations.title: Agreement must specify fees charged to client
obligations.key_phrase: Fees charged to the client. (to be specifically mentioned here)

obligations.title: Act in fiduciary capacity towards clients at all times
obligations.key_phrase: The Investment Adviser shall act in a fiduciary capacity towards its clients at all times

obligations.title: Maintain specified client and advice records
obligations.key_phrase: Maintenance of records i.e. client-wise KYC, risk assessment, analysis reports of investment advice and suitability

obligations.title: Undertaking to abide by Code of Conduct (Third Schedule)
obligations.key_phrase: Undertaking to abide by the Code of Conduct as specified in the Third Schedule

obligations.title: Undertaking to recommend direct implementation of advice
obligations.key_phrase: undertaking from the investment adviser to recommend direct implementation of advice i.e. through direct schemes/direct codes

obligations.title: Agreement must include risk factors statement
obligations.key_phrase: detailed statement of risks associated with each type of investment covering the standard risks

obligations.title: Agreement must specify validity and renewal terms
obligations.key_phrase: Minimum period if any, and provision for renewal, if any, along with terms and conditions for such renewal

obligations.title: Agreement amendment requires mutual written consent
obligations.key_phrase: agreement may be amended by mutual written consent of the parties

obligations.title: Agreement must specify termination conditions including SEBI cancellation
obligations.key_phrase: Suspension/ Cancellation of registration of Investment Adviser by SEBI
